description:
**Blocked by d06.2 (hooks must exist). Read deck §4 "Component
API", §5 "Hooks: state, memo, animation".**

Convert four leaf components from `@behaviour Component`
(`render(state, width) :: [binary()]` shape) to the VDom shape
(functional render returning a `%VNode{}`). They have no children
but exercise state (banner expand/collapse), animation (loader
spinner), and the slot-resolution pattern (header/footer override
hooks already exist in state.ui_overrides).

**Read first:**
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/welcome_banner.ex`
  (~70 lines). Has `expanded` state toggled by `?`. Today's
  `handle_key/2` mutates the struct.
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/header.ex`
  (~80 lines). Same shape as banner — `expanded` toggled by `?`.
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/loader.ex`
  (~60 lines). Spinner reads `System.monotonic_time` directly —
  this MUST stop. Use `use_frame(80)` and read the frame index;
  components must be deterministic in tests.
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/footer.ex`
  (~190 lines). Renders token usage, model, branch, status. No
  state; pure props → vnode.
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/footer_data.ex` — Footer's
  data provider. Continues to be a side-channel; the converted
  Footer reads from it via props pushed through.
- Tests under `apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/` for each.

**Target shape (per component):**
- The module becomes a function module: `def render(props, ctx, h)`.
- `defstruct` and `@behaviour Component` (legacy shape) deleted.
- For Banner/Header: `{expanded, set_expanded} = use_state(h,
  false)`; `use_key(h, ?, fn state -> set_expanded.(state,
  not expanded) end)`.
- For Loader: `frame = use_frame(h, 80)`; pick spinner glyph
  from `elem(@frames, rem(frame, length))`; no
  `System.monotonic_time` calls.
- For Footer: pure render fn — props carry usage/model/branch/
  status; FooterDataProvider read via the parent (Screen root,
  d06.6) and props passed in.
- Each emits a `%VFlow{}` (or `%VRow{}` for single-line outputs)
  composed of `text(...)` helpers from d06.12 (when that lands)
  or %VText{} structs directly if d06.12 hasn't landed yet.
- Theme ALWAYS comes from `ctx.theme` (the `RenderContext`); no
  more theme-as-positional-arg.

**Acceptance:**
- Existing tests pass: banner_test, header_test, loader_test,
  footer_test (or whatever the per-component test files are
  named — find via `ls apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/`).
- Loader test no longer reads wall-clock time — uses an injected
  frame index instead; this is a real test improvement.
- tmux smoke: open the TUI, expand+collapse banner with `?`,
  watch loader animate during a prompt, confirm header/footer
  layout unchanged at width 40, 80, 120, 160.
- Components.WelcomeBanner, Header, Loader, Footer modules
  retain their public function names so callers (Interactive,
  d06.6) don't churn — only the internals migrate.

comments.text: Superseded by the tui2 architecture decision in docs/tui-architecture.md. The d06 plan refactored octo_pi_tui in place; the new direction builds octo_pi_tui2 as a parallel implementation on Filament, leaving octo_pi_tui frozen. New epics: opi-58c, opi-pyl, opi-yhj, opi-t3t, opi-ow9, opi-4tr, opi-m6b. Closing without further work.

title: Convert leaf components: WelcomeBanner, Header, Loader, Footer
